candidates.change_summary: Changed return type from uint8 to uint256 to alter the ABI-encoded return value for callers expecting uint8.
Changed return type from uint8 to bytes32 to alter the ABI-encoded return value for callers expecting uint8.
Changed totalSupply return value from storage variable to a constant 0
Changed totalSupply return value from storage variable to a constant huge number
Remove the condition that msg.sender must be a curated pool, allowing any caller to mint synthetic tokens and alter LP balance tracking.
Delete the line that increments mapSynth_LPDebt, causing the debt tracking to be zero while LP balance increases, changing the ratio.
Delete the line that increments mapSynth_LPBalance, so LP balance is not updated while debt is, causing a divergence.
Replace mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] with mapSynth_LPBalance[member] when adding LP units, storing balance under a different key.
Replace += lpUnits with += amount so LP balance tracks the synthetic amount instead of actual LP units added.
Replace += amount with += lpUnits for debt tracking, so debt increases by LP units instead of synthetic amount, changing the stored ratio.
Delete the call to _getAddedLPAmount, causing lpUnits to be zero and thus mapSynth_LPBalance unchanged.
Replace msg.sender with member in the onlyPool modifier invocation, allowing the member address to be passed as the pool.
